text_block_list.name: TV Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—First up, our top story. 
In light of the global viral outbreak—"

—At first, it felt like something 
happening in a distant world.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Wait... What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
*cough*... Looks like I caught a cold. 
I'm heading home early...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you should. 
There's that outbreak going around, too... 
You've gotta get plenty of rest when your 
immune system is down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Lately, I feel like I've been seeing 
a lot of people wearing masks.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With all the news about the outbreak, 
too... 
We need to be careful.

"Be careful"... I thought that as long as 
we did that, 
the looming unease would soon blow over.

text_block_list.name: TV Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—With no end in sight, large-scale events 
both domestic and abroad are voluntarily 
being canceled—"

text_block_list.name: TV Broadcast
text_block_list.text:
"—In response to this unprecedented 
situation, 
people are being forced to alter their 
daily lives—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a pain... The place where I 
always get lunch 
is temporarily closed starting today. 
Where am I supposed 
to get my mapo tofu bowls now...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Some sporting events are getting called 
off altogether. 
...We might even—

text_block_list.name: Trainer C
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Everyone assemble in the gymnasium! 
—The Director wants to speak with us!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
ATTENTION! Effective immediately, upcoming 
races... 
—WILL BE HELD BEHIND CLOSED DOORS, WITH NO 
SPECTATORS!

—It was an announcement unprecedented 
since the founding of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With the worldwide spread of the 
infectious disease, 
crowds had to be avoided at all costs. 
Naturally, racecourses were no exception.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yet spectators are the very lifeblood of 
racing. 
Numerous viewpoints were raised within the 
URA, including total cancellation. 
The final consensus, under stringent 
preventative measures, was—

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The races will not stop! To ensure that, 
every possible precaution will be carried 
out!

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, isn't that for the best? 
At least they can keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The Classic races starting soon 
only come once in a lifetime... 
Even with restrictions, at least they 
still have the chance...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Then does that mean... we have to 
race with nobody watching?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
That's what it comes down to, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
—That roaring crowd... 
We won't... get to feel it...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
On the very stage we yearned for... 
Not even a single pair of eyes on us?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Win Marilyn.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Oh dear, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...More importantly, we need to focus on 
training! 
It's not as though we're guaranteed a spot 
in the Classic races yet.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm sure there'll be a live 
broadcast... 
It's okay. Being able to run at all is 
more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—So you really won't be able 
to come to Hyogo...?

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right... I'm really sorry, 
Daring Tact. 
We wanted to see you in person so badly, 
but with things the way they are right 
now..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, of course. 
I understand.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact... We're so, so sorry. 
We all banded together and tried to clear 
our schedules to make it work, but..."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, but look on the bright side! Times 
are convenient now. 
We can watch everything on the stream! 
We'll be cheering you on with all our 
might!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"We rewatched your debut race together 
over and over 
and practiced cheering, you know. 
We even had matching happi coats made! 
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Matching happi coats...! 
Oh, I'd love to see them!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you. 
I only wish you could've seen them in 
person..."

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, don't say that in front of 
Daring Tact... Sorry about that, 
he's been pretty down ever since he found 
out he can't 
even go visit his granddaughters..."

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"We'll hang up now. Don't worry, Daring 
Tact, 
right now we just have to hang tough. 
Things'll get better soon. 
Give it your best out there until then, 
okay!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
Thank you so much for calling.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list:
...Things have really taken a turn, 
haven't they?

...Things have really taken a turn, 
haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
With events getting cancelled left and 
right, 
I consider myself very fortunate... 
just to be able to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still... I can't help worrying about 
everyone in Hidaka. 
They seemed quite shaken.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's understandable. Surrounded by a fog 
that shows no sign of clearing...
choice_data_list: Are you doing all right yourself?
Are you doing all right yourself?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Now that circumstances have come to 
this, 
all we can do is adapt.

Daring Tact said it with utter calm. 
Indeed, this is who she truly is. 
She views the harsh realities of life with 
a clear, steely gaze.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
... 
If I truly am a strong horsegirl...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then there is only one thing 
I can do for my hometown right now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And that is to claim the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To live up to the hopes and cheers 
everyone has placed upon me—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And bring hope back to Hidaka 
as a Triple Tiara horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

What is happening across the world is 
beyond what 
any single individual can fix. Even so— 
her heartfelt feelings will surely reach 
them.

A victory by Daring Tact will be a beacon 
of hope for Hidaka. 
Believing that with all my heart—we 
resolve to seize victory.
